result.description: Team messaging and collaboration platform with channels, DMs, files, canvases and workflows.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 v2 authorization-code flow (PKCE supported) yields bot/user tokens (xoxb/xoxp) with granular scopes; app-level tokens for Socket Mode/specific APIs; optional token rotation. Single-workspace apps can use the token shown after installing to own workspace. Webhooks and request-signing for inbound.
result.access_detail: Anyone can create a Slack app free, and any workspace user (admin approval may be required per workspace settings) can install it via OAuth. Marketplace listing/review is only needed for public directory distribution and to use the Slack MCP server; the Web API works for unlisted distributed apps (with stricter rate limits for non-Marketplace apps on conversations.history/replies). Not confirmed from page: free-plan API availability and non-Marketplace limits text.
result.api_notes: Web API is HTTP RPC-style (not strictly REST) at slack.com/api/METHOD with hundreds of methods (chat, conversations, users, files, canvases, search, admin, etc.). Also Events API, Socket Mode (websocket), Block Kit, Workflows, and Real-time Search API. Tiered rate limits per method.
result.blocker: None for Web API toolkit. Note official MCP server restricted to Marketplace-published or internal apps; non-Marketplace apps get stricter rate limits.

evidence.quote: The Slack Web API is an interface for querying information from and enacting change in a Slack workspace.
Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow.
User tokens allow you to work directly on behalf of users when necessary.
OAuth allows a user in any Slack workspace to install your app.
Only apps published in the Slack Marketplace and internal apps can use MCP at this time; unlisted apps are prohibited from using MCP.
The Web API is a collection of HTTP RPC-style methods , all with URLs in the form https://slack.com/api/METHOD_FAMILY.method .
With the Slack MCP server, your integrated apps can search channels, send messages, and perform other Slack actions through MCP clients.
Workspace admins can approve and manage all MCP client integrations, keeping your Slack data safe.
